description: Confusion matrices on test at risk thresholds fixed on 2022
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity; train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: Thresholds from weighted 2022 predictions; test counts weighted (per year) and unweighted; Weighted (WEIGHT) and unweighted metrics; 95% percentile CIs from 200 Rao-Wu rescaled bootstrap replicates of PSU_VAR within PSUSTRAT (seed config.RANDOM_SEED)
